skills.name: ml4t-run-backtest
skills.reason_selected: Native Strategy/Engine simulation and order execution
skills.required_invariants: Use next-event native STOP/MARKET orders and reconcile every fill.
skills.verification: Causal replay uses Engine NEXT_BAR; synthetic cost and data-gap tests use native Engine.

skills.name: ml4t-calendar-ops
skills.required_invariants: Use UTC elapsed intervals and America/Chicago session dates.
skills.verification: Repeated-hour UTC boundary tests pass; entry cap is recomputed from actual fills.

skills.name: ml4t-build-bars
skills.required_invariants: Retain only 30 distinct minute rows and use session-anchored intervals.
skills.verification: Causal bar builder excludes incomplete bars and records counts.

skills.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
skills.reason_selected: Future availability gate and signal timing
skills.required_invariants: Do not read later bar availability when submitting orders.
skills.verification: entry_valid removed; the strategy gets no future-availability field.

skills.name: ml4t-transaction-costs
skills.required_invariants: Record commission, slippage, spread and impact limits.
skills.verification: Full-tick run charges $2.50 and 0.25 points per fill; proxy spread and impact remain unavailable.

skills.name: ml4t-cost-model
skills.required_invariants: Separate cost fields and reconcile to fill and trade ledgers.
skills.verification: Commission and slippage USD reconcile independently to fills and closed trade records.

skills.name: ml4t-continuous-futures
skills.reason_selected: Instrument identity is a CFD proxy
skills.required_invariants: Do not infer CME NQ rolls from an index CFD.
skills.verification: Report labels the source as Dukascopy BID proxy; no futures contract/roll claim.

skills.name: ml4t-validate-data
skills.required_invariants: Check frozen partition hashes, timestamps, OHLC, duplicates, and gaps.
skills.verification: All 163 partition hashes checked before run; quality counts saved.

skills.name: ml4t-walk-forward-cv
skills.required_invariants: Preserve chronology; do not shuffle or tune.
skills.verification: Frozen calendar blocks and yearly summaries are retrospective attribution, not OOS.

skills.name: ml4t-sensitivity-analysis
skills.required_invariants: Do not tune strategy parameters; vary only declared costs.
skills.verification: Zero-cost, historical quarter-tick, and full-tick cases are separately retained.

skills.name: ml4t-stress-test
skills.required_invariants: Report gap-through, same-minute ambiguity, and missing event stress.
skills.verification: Native one-minute fills and synthetic gap/OCO tests expose unresolved execution states.

skills.name: ml4t-backtest-overfitting
skills.required_invariants: Declare all cases and preserve failures; do not claim unreproducible selection adjustment.
skills.verification: Frozen trial matrix includes historical references, new trials, ambiguity diagnostic, and skipped delayed-fill.

skills.name: ml4t-tearsheet
skills.required_invariants: Report equity, drawdown, and block PnL.
skills.verification: phase567_tearsheet.png uses native daily equity ledgers and fixed blocks.

skills.name: ml4t-polars-patterns
skills.required_invariants: Use sorted Polars expressions for bars and summaries.
skills.verification: Parquet loaded lazily; bar, yearly, block, gap and ledger checks use Polars.
